q: How many ascension tiers should there be? Each tier = 1 new island, 2-3 buildings, 3 new items, 1 new Gate item (and 2 harder vows from tier 2). Each island needs ~25 art pieces.
ctx: Draft ladder (ADR 0006): Asc 1 Lotus Marsh, Asc 2 Thunder Crag, Asc 3 Azure Beast Ravine, Asc 4 Tribulation Peak with a true ending. Every run stays ~2 h.
o: 3 tiers (stop at Beast Ravine, ~75 art pieces, no true ending)
4 tiers ending at Tribulation Peak + true ending (~110 art pieces)
6 tiers (adds 2 more islands later, ~160 art pieces)

Lotus Marsh: misty shallows, spirit lotus and reeds, Foundation Pills

beasts

tribulation

sword_tomb

underworld

q: Do the new islands add to the world, or replace older ones? Keeping all islands gives +2 Ascension Points per island (about 21 AP per run today, ~33 at tier 4) but more to unlock each run.
o: add
Add: every island stays. New recipes make the old slow steps faster, so runs stay ~2 h
replace
Replace: each tier seals one early island (e.g. Lotus Marsh takes the Farm's place)
add_free
Add, and older islands start unlocked for free from tier 2 on

q: How should harder vows pay? Today the bonus depends only on how many vows you take (1 vow x1.15 up to 4 vows x1.75), so a hard vow pays the same as an easy one.
ctx: New vows in the draft: Withered Fields, Narrow Bridge (Asc 2); Wrathful Beasts, Silent Altar (Asc 3); Forgotten Path, Heavenly Tribulation (Asc 4).
o: weights
Each vow has its own bonus (+15% to +50%), pick any mix, total capped at x3
levels
One Tribulation level 1-5 per run, each level adds a fixed set of rules
count
Keep paying by count, just add the new vows to the list

q: What happens after the last tier (the true ending)?
o: endless
Keep ascending at the last tier: vows and the perk shop are the replay goal
tribulation_levels
Endless numbered tribulations: each later run gets slightly harder for slightly more AP
stop
The game is finished; ascending is no longer offered
